stem:
Activity A has no predecessors and a duration of 6 days. Using a forward scan (earliest start time = 0 for activities with no predecessors), what is the earliest finish time (EFT) of activity A?

Earliest finish time = EST + duration.
hint: EST of A = 0. EFT = EST + duration.
explanation:
$$\text{EFT}_A = \text{EST}_A + \text{duration}_A = 0 + 6 = 6$$

Activity A can finish as early as day 6.

stem:
Activity B has an earliest start time (EST) of 8 days and a latest start time (LST) of 11 days. What is the float (slack) of activity B?

Float = LST − EST.
explanation:
$$\text{Float}_B = \text{LST}_B - \text{EST}_B = 11 - 8 = 3 \text{ days}$$

Activity B can be delayed by up to 3 days without delaying the project.

stem:
A project must be completed in 20 days. Activity D is the last activity and has a duration of 4 days. Using a backward scan, what is the latest start time (LST) of activity D?

For the last activity: LST = project duration − duration of the activity.
explanation:
$$\text{LST}_D = 20 - 4 = 16 \text{ days}$$

Activity D must start no later than day 16 to ensure the project finishes on time.

stem: Activity A (duration 3 days) and Activity B (duration 5 days) both have no predecessors, so each has EST = 0. Activity C cannot start until both A and B are finished. What is the earliest start time (EST) of activity C?
hint: C must wait for the later of A's finish and B's finish. EFT of A = 0 + 3 = 3. EFT of B = 0 + 5 = 5. EST of C = max(3, 5).
explanation:
The earliest C can start is the latest of the finish times of A and B:
$$\text{EFT}_A = 0 + 3 = 3$$
$$\text{EFT}_B = 0 + 5 = 5$$
$$\text{EST}_C = \max(3, 5) = 5$$

C cannot start until day 5.

stem:
A project has the following activities (duration in days):

| Activity | Predecessors | Duration |
|---|---|---|
| A | — | 3 |
| B | — | 6 |
| C | A, B | 4 |
| D | A | 5 |
| E | C, D | 2 |

Perform a forward scan and find the EST of activity C.
hint: C must wait for both A and B. EST of C = max(EFT of A, EFT of B).
explanation:
$$\text{EFT}_A = 0 + 3 = 3$$
$$\text{EFT}_B = 0 + 6 = 6$$
$$\text{EST}_C = \max(3, 6) = 6$$

C can start no earlier than day 6.

stem: A project has a minimum completion time of 18 days. Activity F has a duration of 4 days and is the last activity before the finish. Using a backward scan, what is the latest start time (LST) of activity F?
hint: LST of the last activity = project duration − duration of that activity.
explanation:
$$\text{LST}_F = 18 - 4 = 14 \text{ days}$$

If F starts any later than day 14, the project will not finish on time.

stem:
A project has the following activities:

| Activity | Predecessors | Duration (days) |
|---|---|---|
| A | — | 5 |
| B | A | 3 |
| C | A | 4 |
| D | B, C | 2 |
| E | D | 6 |

After performing a complete forward and backward scan, the project duration is 17 days. The LST of D is 9 days and its EST is 9 days. What is the float of activity B?

(Hint: EFT of A = 5. EST of B = 5. EFT of B = 8. LST of D = 9, so LST of B = 9 − 3 = 6.)
hint: Float of B = LST of B − EST of B.
explanation:
Forward scan:
$$\text{EST}_A = 0,\ \text{EFT}_A = 5$$
$$\text{EST}_B = 5,\ \text{EFT}_B = 8$$
$$\text{EST}_C = 5,\ \text{EFT}_C = 9$$
$$\text{EST}_D = \max(8, 9) = 9,\ \text{EFT}_D = 11$$
$$\text{EST}_E = 11,\ \text{EFT}_E = 17$$

Backward scan:
$$\text{LST}_E = 17 - 6 = 11$$
$$\text{LST}_D = 11 - 2 = 9$$
$$\text{LST}_C = 9 - 4 = 5$$
$$\text{LST}_B = 9 - 3 = 6$$
$$\text{LST}_A = \min(5, 6) = 5$$

Float of B:
$$\text{Float}_B = \text{LST}_B - \text{EST}_B = 6 - 5 = 1 \text{ day}$$

Using the same project as the previous question:

| Activity | Predecessors | Duration (days) |
|---|---|---|
| A | — | 3 |
| B | — | 5 |
| C | A | 4 |
| D | A, B | 2 |
| E | A | 6 |
| F | C, D, E | 3 |

Complete the forward scan and find the minimum project completion time.
hint: Find EFT of each activity in order. The minimum completion time equals EFT of F.
explanation:
Forward scan:
$$\text{EFT}_A = 3,\quad \text{EFT}_B = 5$$
$$\text{EST}_C = 3,\quad \text{EFT}_C = 7$$
$$\text{EST}_D = \max(3, 5) = 5,\quad \text{EFT}_D = 7$$
$$\text{EST}_E = 3,\quad \text{EFT}_E = 9$$
$$\text{EST}_F = \max(7, 7, 9) = 9,\quad \text{EFT}_F = 12$$

The minimum project completion time is **12 days**.

stem:
A project has the following activities:

| Activity | Predecessors | Duration (days) |
|---|---|---|
| A | — | 3 |
| B | — | 5 |
| C | A | 4 |
| D | A, B | 2 |
| E | A | 6 |
| F | C, D, E | 3 |

The minimum project completion time is 12 days. Perform a backward scan and find the float of activity D.
hint: LST of F = 12 − 3 = 9. LST of D = 9 − 2 = 7. EST of D = 5. Float of D = LST − EST.
explanation:
From the forward scan: $\text{EST}_D = 5$.

Backward scan:
$$\text{LST}_F = 12 - 3 = 9$$
$$\text{LST}_D = \text{LST}_F - \text{dur}_D = 9 - 2 = 7$$

Float of D:
$$\text{Float}_D = \text{LST}_D - \text{EST}_D = 7 - 5 = 2 \text{ days}$$

Activity D has 2 days of float — it can be delayed by up to 2 days without affecting the project completion time.

stem:
A project has the following activities:

| Activity | Predecessors | Duration (days) |
|---|---|---|
| A | — | 3 |
| B | — | 5 |
| C | A | 4 |
| D | A, B | 2 |
| E | A | 6 |
| F | C, D, E | 3 |

The minimum project completion time is 12 days. Perform a complete backward scan and find the latest start time (LST) of activity B.
hint: Work backwards from F. LST of F = 9. LST of D = 7. LST of B = LST of D − duration of B.
explanation:
Backward scan (project duration = 12):
$$\text{LST}_F = 12 - 3 = 9$$
$$\text{LST}_C = 9 - 4 = 5$$
$$\text{LST}_D = 9 - 2 = 7$$
$$\text{LST}_E = 9 - 6 = 3$$
$$\text{LST}_A = \min(5, 7, 3) = 3 \implies \text{LST}_A = 3 - 3 = 0$$

For B: only D follows B, so:
$$\text{LST}_B = \text{LST}_D - \text{dur}_B = 7 - 5 = 2$$

Activity B must start by day 2 at the latest.
